verdict.rationale: v0 supports GitHub sync: connect a project to a repo, work on isolated branches, push commits, run CI, and open PRs, plus importing existing GitHub code as a starting point—enabling a local-editor + push-back workflow. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of pulling remote/local edits back into v0 (bidirectional sync) and independent hands-on confirmation that local-tool edits merge cleanly without conflicts beyond the built-in 'Fix Conflicts' tool.
